points.title: 政治家
points.description: 伯里克利早年参与雅典政治，逐渐成为民主政治的领导者。
points.descriptionEn: Pericles began his political career in Athens, gradually becoming a leader of the democratic political system.

points.title: 雅典执政官
points.description: 伯里克利在位期间，雅典达到全盛，进行了一系列公共建筑和艺术创作。
points.descriptionEn: During his tenure, Athens reached its peak, with numerous public buildings and artistic creations.

points.title: 政治家
points.description: 晚年，伯里克利领导雅典进行西西里远征，但最终失败，导致雅典的衰落。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Pericles led Athens in the Sicilian Expedition, which ended in failure, leading to the decline of Athens.

supporter.zh: 伯里克利被认为是雅典民主的守护者，他的政策促进了雅典的文化繁荣。
supporter.en: Pericles is considered the guardian of Athenian democracy, whose policies promoted the cultural prosperity of Athens.

critic.zh: 批评者认为伯里克利的西西里远征是雅典衰败的导火索。
critic.en: Critics argue that Pericles' Sicilian Expedition was a catalyst for the decline of Athens.

objective.zh: 作为古希腊最杰出的政治家之一，伯里克利的遗产在政治和艺术上都产生了深远影响。
objective.en: As one of the greatest political figures of ancient Greece, Pericles' legacy has had a profound impact on politics and art.

self.en: Democracy is the welfare of the city-state.

others.en: He was the glory of Athens.
